senses.gloss: (cmp. פִּיקָה I; φῦκος, fucus, of Semitic origin) [coil,]

sea-weed or rock-lichen used as a dye; red color, rouge. Sifra M’tsorʿa, Neg., Par. 1 (ref. to שני, Lev. XIV, 4) יכול פ׳ ת״ל תולעת from שני you might infer that you may use the dye from fucus, therefore tolaʿath is added (to indicate that it must be won from a worm, the snail); Yalk. Lev. 559 פִּיקִים.

units: <cite ref="Bava Metzia 88b:3">B. Mets. 88ᵇ</cite> (expl. <he>משיפקסו</he>, <cite ref="Mishnah Maasrot 1:5">Maasr. I, 5</cite>) <he>משינטל פ׳ שלהן</he> (Rashi to <cite ref="Beitzah 13b">Bets. 13ᵇ</cite> <cite ref="Q01496"><he>פֶּקֶס</he></cite>) as soon as their blossoms are removed.
<cite ref="Bekhorot 45a">Bekh. 45ᵃ</cite> Var. Ar., v. <cite ref="Q00796"><he>פִּיקָה</he> I</cite>.
